name: AppealGo API
description: Scan a UK parking ticket, council PCN, private parking charge, bus lane, ULEZ or Clean Air Zone notice, get the grounds and a drafted appeal, and have AppealGo file it. Checking is free; filing costs £7.99 per notice or is covered by a plan, up to its appeal allowance. Each key may run 25 scans per day. An MCP server exposing the same operations is at https://appealgo.com/api/mcp.
